page.overview:
Who is Gabriel Bortoleto?

Gabriel Lourenzo Bortoleto Oliveira "Gabi" (born 14 October 2004) is a Brazilian racing driver competing in the Formula 1 World Championship for Audi starting in .

A member of the McLaren Driver Development Program from 2023 to 2024, Bortoleto completed his first Formula One test at the Red Bull Ring in September 2024, driving the McLaren MCL36. He joined Sauber in Formula One for the season, ahead of their acquisition by Audi in .

It was announced that Bortoleto would partner Nico Hülkenberg on a multi-year deal from 2025 onwards; the two will replace outgoing duo Valtteri Bottas and Zhou Guanyu. He will become the first F2 champion to be directly promoted to a racing seat in Formula 1 since Mick Schumacher's promotion to Haas in 2021 after winning the 2020 Formula 2 championship.
